# threews-agent-starter

> Live 3D AI agent in one page. A responsive, Codespaces-ready <agent-3d> starter with motion, speech, a keyless create command and a ten-minute learning path.

threews-agent-starter is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [Start in Codespaces](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/README.md#start-in-codespaces)
- [Make the character yours](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/README.md#make-the-character-yours)
- [The whole integration](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/README.md#the-whole-integration)
- [Verify](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/README.md#verify)
- [License](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/README.md#license)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-agent-starter/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
